Rashi on Megillah 13b:10:1.english: The Tarsian language - [Tursi is] the name of a place:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:10:2.hebrew: לא ראינו שינה - מתוך שהיתה חביבה עליו, היה מרבה בתשמיש וצמא לשתות:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:10:2.english: We have not seen sleep - Because she [Esther] was dear to him [Ahasuerus], he would engage frequently in marital relations and become thirsty to drink.

Rashi on Megillah 13b:11:1.english: My post and your post - You are appointed over one task, and I am appointed over another task:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:12:1.hebrew: הכי גרסינן: "אחר הדברים האלה גדל המלך את המן וגו'" - בתר בגתן ותרש כתיב:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:12:1.english: This is our textual reading: "After these things, the king promoted Haman, etc." - It is written after [the episode of] Bigtan and Teresh:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:12:2.hebrew: וקא בעי הש"ס "אחר מאי" - מה העיד עליו הכתוב, שלא גידלו עד שבא מעשה הזה:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:12:2.english: And the Talmud asks, "After what?" - What is Scripture testifying regarding him, that [the king] did not promote him until this incident occurred:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:12:3.english: After the Holy One, Blessed be He, created a remedy for the blow - that is destined to come after [some] time:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:13:1.hebrew: כרפאי לישראל - ואחר כך נגלה עון אפרים ע"י מכה שאני מביא עליהן:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:13:1.english: When I heal Israel - and afterward the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered through a strike that I bring upon them:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:15:1.hebrew: הפיל פור - ומהו "פור"? "הוא הגורל". "מיום ליום" — באיזו יום יפול הגורל, וכן "מחודש לחודש", והגורל של כולן הטיל ביום אחד, ונפל לו הגורל על אחד:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:15:1.english: He cast pur - And what is pur? "It is the lot." "From day to day" — [meaning] on which day the lot would fall, and likewise "from month to month." And he cast the lot for all of them on one day, and the lot fell for him on one [of them]:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:15:2.hebrew: בשבעה באדר מת משה - שנאמר: "והעם עלו מן הירדן בעשור לחודש הראשון" (יהושע ד׳:י״ט), צא מהם למפרע שלשים יום באבלו של משה, ושלשה ימים שהכינו להם צידה, שנאמר: "הכינו לכם צידה כי בעוד שלשה ימים אתם עוברים וגו'" (שם א), הרי בשבעה באדר מת משה:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:15:2.english: On the seventh of Adar Moses died - As it is stated: "And the people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth [day] of the first month" (Joshua 4:19). Count backward from them thirty days for the mourning of Moses, and three days [during] which they prepared provisions for themselves, as it is stated: "Prepare provisions for yourselves, for within three days you are crossing, etc." (ibid., 1); thus, on the seventh of Adar Moses died.

Rashi on Megillah 13b:15:3.hebrew: ובשבעה באדר נולד - דכתיב: "בן מאה ועשרים שנה אנכי היום" (דברים ל״א:ב׳) — היום מלאו ימי ושנותי; כדאי הלידה שתכפר על המיתה:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:15:3.english: And on the seventh of Adar he was born - as it is written: "I am one hundred and twenty years old today" (Deuteronomy 31:2) — [meaning,] today my days and my years are completed; [therefore,] the birth is worthy to atone for the death:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:17:1.english: There are rabbis among them - From Haman's answer we learn that Ahasuerus answered him thus.

Rashi on Megillah 13b:18:1.english: I am making a bald spot in your kingdom - [meaning] that one kingdom is full of them:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:19:1.english: And they do not take from us - women [as wives]:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:19:2.hebrew: ואת דתי המלך אינם עושים - אונגריות, ומסים, וגולגליות, וארנונות אינן נותנין:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:19:2.english: And the king's laws they do not keep - They do not pay forced-labor levies, taxes, poll taxes, and crop taxes.

Rashi on Megillah 13b:19:3.hebrew: דמפקי ליה לשתא בשה"י פה"י - שבת היום, פסח היום, ואנו אסורים במלאכה:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:19:3.english: That they spend the year with shehi pehi - "[It is] Shabbat today [Shabbat hayom], [it is] Passover today [Pesach hayom], and we are forbidden from [doing] work."

Rashi on Megillah 13b:19:4.english: It does not profit [the king] - It is not fitting, and there is no reason to care about leaving them [alone]:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:1:1.hebrew: לא יגרע מצדיק עיניו - נותן עיניו במעשה הצדיקים, לשלם להם אף לימים רבים, מדה במדה:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:1:1.english: He withdraws not His eyes from the righteous - [He] sets His eyes upon the deeds of the righteous, to reward them even after many days, measure for measure:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:1:2.english: She merited that Saul descended from her - who was modest:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:1:3.hebrew: זכה ויצאת ממנו אסתר - בתרגום של מגילה מייחס מרדכי ועושהו עשירי לשאול, ומשאול עד בנימין, וכתיב "היא אסתר בת דודו", ואין לו ראיה אחרת בכתובים שיצאה משאול:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:1:3.english: He merited that Esther should descend from him - In the Targum of the Megillah, it traces Mordecai's lineage and makes him the tenth [generation] from Saul, and from Saul to Benjamin; and it is written, "that is, Esther, his uncle's daughter" [Esther 2:7], and he has no other proof in Scripture that she descended from Saul:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:21:1.english: [They] announce - The court proclaims that they should bring shekels to the Temple:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:21:2.hebrew: ועל הכלאים - שגדלו הזרעים קצת וניצן ניכר, ועוקרין אותן משדותיהן בהכרזת בית דין:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:21:2.english: And about diverse kinds - [They announce this] because the seeds have grown a little and their sprout is recognizable, and they uproot them from their fields upon the announcement of the court.

Rashi on Megillah 13b:5:1.hebrew: מסרתן - ללאה, והוא צניעות שלא יתפרסם הדבר שמסר לה יעקב סימנין:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:5:1.english: She gave them - to Leah, and this is [an act of] modesty, so that the matter that [Jacob] had given her signs would not become publicly known:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:6:1.hebrew: שנאמר לא יגרע מצדיק עיניו - וסיפיה דקרא: "ויושיבם לנצח ויגבהו", והיינו גדולה לדורות:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:6:1.english: As it is stated: “He does not withdraw His eyes from the righteous” - And the end of the verse [is]: “and He establishes them forever, and they are exalted,” and this is greatness for [all] generations:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:6:2.hebrew: ואם הגיס דעתו כו' - הכי סמכי קראי: "ויושיבם לנצח ויגבהו", "ואם אסורים בזקים" — על ידי שמגביהין עצמן, באין לידי עניות ויסורים:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:6:2.english: And if he becomes arrogant, etc. - This is how the verses are juxtaposed: "He establishes them forever, and they are exalted," "And if they are bound in chains" — because they exalt themselves, they come to poverty and suffering:

Rashi on Megillah 13b:7:1.hebrew: וטובלת - מחמת נקיות, שלא תהא מאוסה לצדיק משכיבתו של אחשורוש:
Rashi on Megillah 13b:7:1.english: And [she would] immerse herself - [She did so] out of cleanliness, so that she would not be repulsive to the righteous one [Mordecai] from Ahasuerus's lying [with her].

Rashi on Megillah 13b:8:1.english: A master with his servants - [As it is written,] "And Pharaoh became angry with his two courtiers":

Tosafot on Megillah 13b:22:1.hebrew: הכסף נתון לך - גימטריא דהכסף עולה הע"ץ, רמז לו שיתלה עליו:
Tosafot on Megillah 13b:22:1.english: The silver is given to you - The gematria of hakesef ("the silver") equals [that of] ha'etz ("the gallows"), an allusion to him that he would be hanged upon it:

Tosafot on Megillah 13b:7:1.hebrew: וטובלת ויושבת בחיקו של מרדכי - ואם תאמר, והא לא הי' שם הבחנת שלש' חדשים, שהרי בכל יום היה אותו רשע מצוי אצלה? וי"ל שהיתה משמשת במוך:
Tosafot on Megillah 13b:7:1.english: And immerse herself and sit in the lap of Mordecai - And if you will ask: Was there not [the requirement of] a three-month waiting period [to distinguish paternity], for every day that wicked man was with her? One can say that she used a contraceptive wad:
